{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tapani calendar''' was a calendar used in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] for domestic affairs. It was established by [[Shey Tapani]] in local year 5,412 (or [[7308 BBY]]). Though the Tapani sector used the [[Galactic Standard Calendar|Imperial calendar]] when dealing with the outside galaxy, the local calendar remained in common use internally, and was seen as a symbol of the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] autonomy. It was slightly adjusted to better conform to [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|Galactic Standard Time]], but retained the traditional names of months, days, and holidays used in the sector.

The calendar's Year 0 was [[12,720 BBY]], date of the first colonists arriving in the region.
